policy: NO ranking, NO "winner", NO cross-framework speed claim. This file compares StreetUI v1.4 ONLY against StreetUI v1.3 (same environment, same harness), plus the within-run SSR serialize A/B. Cross-framework comparison is BLOCKED (see competitor-browser.json) and intentionally absent.
environment: Node + happy-dom for node/SSR; esbuild for bundle. NOT browser numbers.

ssrSerializePhase_sameProcessAB.note: Same /users tree, same process. legacy = pre-v1.4 serializer replica.

ssrPhaseSplit_users10k.note: renderToString = mount (dominant) + serialize. Escape is ~3%; optimization targeted serialize allocation, not escape volume.

caveat: End-to-end renderToString cross-run medians are too noisy in this 2-core VM to quote a percentage; the SSR speedup is reported as the deterministic same-process serialize A/B only.
